name: wait for the initial document
D0 demo document loaded: Timber Beam stock with 4 steps
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;await h.actions();await h.stepsNow(s=>s.n===4,150000,'demo steps');window.__doc=async()=>{const h=window.__h;if(!h.find('Add Step…'))await h.actions();const s=h.steps();if(!h.labels().length||!document.querySelector('[data-slot=tree-label]')){h.click('Artifact');await h.wait(800)}return {steps:s,rows:h.labels(),picker:document.querySelector('[role=combobox][aria-label=Example]').innerText.trim()}};h.click('Artifact');await h.until(()=>h.find('Cut Lap Joint'),30000,'rows');const d=await window.__doc();h.ok(d.rows.includes('Timber Beam')&&Math.abs(d.steps.vol-0.174)<1e-3,'demo '+h.json(d));return h.json(d)})()

name: D1 Set Stock Cylinder replaces the stock and resets the timeline
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;await h.form('Set Stock…');await h.pick("Cylinder");await h.exec();const s=await h.stepsNow(s=>s.n===0&&Math.abs(s.vol-0.282700)/0.282700<0.03,120000,'Cylinder stock with 0 steps and 0.2827 m³');h.click('Artifact');await h.wait(800);const rows=h.labels();h.ok(!rows.includes('Cut Lap Joint')&&!rows.includes('Drill Dowel Hole'),'old steps remain '+h.json(rows));return h.json({s,rows})})()

name: D2 Set Stock keeps the installed workshop
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;h.click('Workshop');await h.until(()=>h.find('Table Saw'),30000,'workshop');const l=h.labels();for(const m of ['Generic Saw','Table Saw','CNC Router'])h.ok(l.includes(m),'workshop kept '+m+' '+h.json(l));h.click('Artifact');return h.json(l)})()

name: D3 Set Active Example offers the registered examples
js: (async()=>{const h=window.__h;await h.form('Set Active Example…');const boxes=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=combobox]')].filter(b=>b.getAttribute('aria-label')!=='Example');boxes[boxes.length-1].click();await h.wait(800);const opts=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=option]')].map(e=>e.innerText.trim());document.activeElement&&document.activeElement.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape',bubbles:true}));await h.wait(500);for(const o of ['Timber Beam Joinery','Drilled Plate','Concrete Forest'])h.ok(opts.includes(o),'option '+o+' in '+h.json(opts));return h.json(opts)})()
